null_time_reasons.time_utc: Absolute UTC of modeled bulk release is unknown; scenario-relative travel times do not supply it
null_time_reasons.time_uncertainty: No independently audited absolute release-time uncertainty is available
null_time_reasons.available_time: Scenario evidence has no established historical forecast information-availability cutoff
null_time_reasons.forecast_reference_time: Not applicable: these are conditional propagation scenarios
null_time_reasons.issue_time: Not applicable: this package is not an issued forecast
null_time_reasons.valid_time: Not applicable: no absolute forecast-valid timestamp is established

space_object.position_uncertainty_reason: Candidate source/target geometry lacks independently quantified positional error
space_object.target_detection_geometry: registered cell centres inside 100m buffers; entity_id distinguishes five OSM representatives from three candidate objects

time.detection_interval: previous saved output below threshold to first above; not numerical solver-step timing

depth.definition: model flow depth; native representation and initial depth/terrain differences retained per run

horizontal_speed.definition: horizontal east/north magnitude or explicitly marked along-path equivalent

native_scalar_speed.definition: ravaflow terrain-corrected scalar, retained separately from horizontal speed

release_volume.definition: actual release-grid integral, checked against the explicitly delivered parent mapping and native t0 representation where present
release_volume.legacy_reference_field: expected_reference_grid_volume_m3 is an inherited standard h15 baseline reference, not the expected release volume for every thickness or Q2-mapped scenario

stationary_residual.definition: last saved-state h>=0.1m and horizontal speed<0.1m/s; multiphase uses maximum over phases with h_phase>=1e-6m
stationary_residual.interpretation: finite-time stationary residual, not permanent or observed deposit; missing conservative phase velocity remains unavailable

quality_control: actual native saved times and requested horizon distinguished
arrival threshold h>=0.1m within registered 100m buffers
sampling definitions, boundary evidence and native mass-budget limitations retained
variable_semantics.qualification: QC gates do not establish predictive or mass-conservation qualification

common_context.scenario_lineage_semantics: Explicit upstream Q2 model/parameter/base scenario/mapping are retained where delivered; missing upstream fields mean unknown Q2 parent and are never inferred from a generic conditional scenario

scientific_acceptance_decision.type: Scientific acceptance and output-semantics decision; no new experiments, parameters or retrospective percentage pass line.
scientific_acceptance_decision.applies_to: All regional scenario outputs from all frameworks in new rolling and final v3+ packets. Frozen v1/v2 bytes are not altered.
scientific_acceptance_decision.include_in_arrival_envelope_requires: Explicit presence in accepted_arrival_envelope_run_ids plus execution/time/material/field/boundary checks; empty list currently means all false.
scientific_acceptance_decision.conditional_diagnostic_range_eligible_sc: Optional execution/time/field/material/boundary diagnostic gate only; NOT mass conservation, regional accuracy, predictive qualification or accepted arrival ensemble. Existing stricter review04 exclusions remain.
scientific_acceptance_decision.passes_execution_time_boundary_gates_sco: Separate raw execution diagnostic. Preserve original brackets, actual end times, non-arrival, missing, failures and domain flags.
scientific_acceptance_decision.diagnostic_observation_available_scope: Raw process/target observation availability; it can remain available even when boundary affected or scientific acceptance is false.
basis: Reduced thin-steep-flow counterexample excludes regional timing accuracy despite a closed mass ledger.
Single-phase actual-control CFL-only comparison changes saved peak speed and arrival bracket materially; convergence is not established.
D-Claw expanded-domain raw mass audit leaves an unresolved mass deficit; dilation is not a general mass source.
Composite-solid/water physical mapping is valid but native mass budgets drift; material legality and solver completion are separate from numerical qualification.
Compact Q2 source cases show native internal budget drift including newly completed p0072; a fixed blacklist cannot cover future unaccepted cases.
No model has a preregistered, demonstrated full regional accuracy qualification or accepted independent local validation. No tolerance is invented from the observed results.
scientific_acceptance_decision.interpretation_of_prior_v1_flags: The 12 old true rows were explicitly execution/field/time/boundary gates only, never physical accuracy or predictive validation. New v3+ semantics reserves include_in_arrival_envelope for accepted runs and records diagnostic gates separately.

fullmask_volume_reference_semantics_anno.scope: input identity and metadata interpretation only; no scientific qualification granted

delivered_Q2_catalogue_provenance.scope: delivered source/material/parameter lineage only; generic Q4 scenarios without explicit Q2 parent remain unknown

registered_applicability_completion.applicability_review_status: registered decision03; mathematical implementation invalidity not claimed for excluded material proxies

actual_native_input_control_provenance.provenance_scope: Actual acquired generated *.data/native parameter/run scripts and raster/topo inputs; execution-time provenance only where explicitly recorded by runtime owner

scheduling_resource_context.wall_time_interpretation: actual elapsed wall time under mixed concurrency and CPU quota regimes; no controlled model runtime/performance comparison

native_output_semantics: cumulative total depth uses native hflow_max ASCII max_t(sum phase depths); raw nout phase-max sum and max-phase horizontal speed are separately labelled; no cross-engine peak-speed ranking
